video:video.video:description: Ships were seen in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday amid continued tensions between the U.S. and Iran which both claim control over the narrow waterway that is vital to global energy supply.

video:video.video:description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow on Saturday to try to revive a stalled push to end the Russian military operation in Ukraine, Russian state news outlets reported.

video:video.video:description: Robert Pattinson shares what it was like switching between "Batman," "Dune," "The Odyssey" and "Primetime" - which he is premiering in Venice.

video:video.video:title: Orlando Bloom talks working on 'Bucking Fastard' set
video:video.video:description: Orlando Bloom says "Bucking Fastard" director Werner Herzog “creates a sacred space for magic to happen.”

video:video.video:title: Musician Phoebe Bridgers hits the red carpet
video:video.video:description: Musician Phoebe Bridgers sailed into Venice on Saturday to walk the premiere red carpet for drama "Primetime."

video:video.video:title: Live snakes audition for a place on stage at famed Met Opera
video:video.video:description: Pretty much everyone on stage at the Metropolitan Opera in New York must audition — even the snake who briefly takes center stage in an upcoming adaptation of Mozart classic opera "Così fan tutte.”

video:video.video:description: At the Venice Film Festival press conference for "Father Joe," Ever Anderson - the daughter of Milla Jovovich and Paul W. S.

video:video.video:description: Brooklyn and Nicola Peltz Beckham attend the Kinéo Awards in Venice, where Peltz Beckham was presented with the Rising Star Award. (Sept. 5)

video:video.video:title: Gravediggers compete in Hungary to spotlight a demanding profession
video:video.video:description: Nineteen two-man teams competed Saturday in a grave-digging competition in northern Hungary, turning mounds of earth in a bid to spotlight the physical demands and professionalism of a trade often overshadowed by taboos surrounding death.

video:video.video:title: Injured people in Iran hospital recall strikes that killed five at wedding in south of country
video:video.video:description: Survivors of a recent strike at a wedding event in southern Iran recalled the harrowing moments of the explosions that killed 5 people and injured dozens, from their hospital beds on Saturday.

video:video.video:title: Lebanon says 3, including a child, killed in Israeli strikes in the south and in Bekaa Valley
video:video.video:description: Lebanon’s health ministry said three people were killed and 23 wounded in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon and the eastern Bekaa Valley on Friday.

video:video.video:title: Algeria authorities attempting to rescue 10-year-old boy trapped in a well
video:video.video:description: Rescue operations continued Saturday in northwestern Algeria for a 10-year-old boy trapped in a well for a fourth consecutive day, as civil defense officials said they were losing hope of finding him alive.

video:video.video:title: Oil deal promises prosperity as Venezuelans endure power crisis
video:video.video:description: President Donald Trump and Venezuela’s interim authorities are promising prosperity, investment and an influx of money after a sweeping oil deal.

video:video.video:title: Brooklyn Beckham supports wife Nicola Peltz Beckham in Venice
video:video.video:description: Brooklyn Beckham supports his wife Nicola Peltz Beckham as she receives the Rising Star Award at the Kinéo Awards in Venice.

video:video.video:title: Gallagher brothers bring rock n roll to Venice
video:video.video:description: The Gallagher brothers brought rock n roll to the Venice Film Festival with their documentary "Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger."

video:video.video:title: Africa’s mother tongues are finding new life as youth connect with roots and relatives
video:video.video:description: Growing interest in African languages is creating new business opportunities as people in the diaspora seek to connect with their relatives and roots.

video:video.video:title: Putin meets with US envoys at the Kremlin in new Ukraine peace talks
video:video.video:description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visited the Kremlin as both Russia and Ukraine escalated aerial attacks.

video:video.video:title: Robert Pattinson premieres 'Primetime' in Venice
video:video.video:description: Robert Pattinson and partner Suki Waterhouse walk the red carpet for the Venice Film Festival premiere of drama, "Primetime." (Sept. 5)

video:video.video:title: Rescuers in Nepal pull a Chinese national and a woman alive 10 days after floods
video:video.video:description: Rescuers in Nepal pulled out a Chinese man and a woman in separate operations Saturday, 10 days after devastating floods hit the country, as teams continued searching for thousands of people still missing.

video:video.video:title: US military hits 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying Navy warships were targeted with missiles
video:video.video:description: The U.S. military on Saturday said it struck three Iranian oil tankers after Navy warships were targeted with missiles, warning that it would “if necessary, destroy Iran’s limited and exposed oil fleet.”

video:video.video:title: A fuel tanker explosion in west Iran kills 11 and injures 7
video:video.video:description: A fuel tanker exploded in western Iran, killing 11 people and injuring seven others, according to the state media.

video:video.video:title: Dozens of masked anti-immigration protesters block roads leading to Britain’s busiest ferry port
video:video.video:description: Dozens of masked anti-immigration protesters blocked roads leading to Britain’s busiest ferry port on Saturday, clogging traffic and disrupting travelers and cargo vehicles heading for France.

video:video.video:title: Kim Jong Un says North Korea building 'overwhelming' power as he commissions second navy destroyer
video:video.video:description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un put his second naval destroyer into service and called for building a more reliable nuclear deterrent, state media reported Monday, as the U.S., South Korea and Japan held a trilateral military exercise he views as a security threat.

video:video.video:title: Noel and Liam Gallagher bring Oasis doc to Venice
video:video.video:description: Noel and Liam Gallagher hit the red carpet in Venice for the world premiere of their new documentary, "Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger," screening out of competition at the festival.

video:video.video:title: Anglers capture dramatic footage of Anak Krakatau volcano eruption in Indonesia
video:video.video:description: Indonesia’s Anak Krakatau volcano erupted early Sunday, forcing the cancellation of flights at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and disrupting services at other airports as volcanic ash spread across western Indonesia.

video:video.video:title: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon kill 4 people and wound 20 others
video:video.video:description: The strikes also destroyed an empty hospital, according to Lebanon’s Health Ministry. A ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah has largely halted fighting in Lebanon for more than two months.

video:video.video:title: Months after Venezuela's earthquakes, one family refuses to give up search for missing relative
video:video.video:description: Antonella Molina and her nephew Pedro are searching for 18-year-old Andres Molina in La Guaira, Venezuela. They haven't heard from him since the earthquakes on June 24.

video:video.video:title: German region votes in election that could bring first far-right state government to power
video:video.video:description: The vote for the state legislature in Saxony-Anhalt has gained outsized prominence because it represents the best chance yet of a governor's post for the far-right, anti-migration Alternative for Germany, or AfD.

video:video.video:title: Boy, 10, dies in Algerian well after days of rescue efforts
video:video.video:description: Rescue operations ended Saturday night in northwestern Algeria for a 10-year-old boy trapped in a well.

video:video.video:title: German region votes in election that could bring first far-right state governor to power
video:video.video:description: Voters cast ballots Sunday in Saxony-Anhalt's state election, with the far-right AfD party hoping to make history by winning its first state government in postwar Germany.

video:video.video:title: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner meet Putin in Moscow
video:video.video:description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner at the Kremlin on Saturday for talks to try to revive a stalled push for peace between Russia and Ukraine.

video:video.video:title: Susan Sarandon says she's lost roles over pro-Palestine stance
video:video.video:description: Speaking at a Venice Film Festival press conference, Susan Sarandon said she's still losing work because of her public support of Palestine. (Sept. 6)

video:video.video:title: The Iranian school struck in the war’s earliest attacks is now a memorial for children
video:video.video:description: With desks half buried, ceilings collapsed and photographs of the victims lining the site, the school has become a memorial to those killed in one the earliest moments of the war that the United States and Israel began across Iran.

video:video.video:title: Mother mourns children and husband killed in Israeli attack on Gaza after bodies found a year on
video:video.video:description: Relatives of Palestinians killed in the Gaza war gathered to pay their respects after their remains were recovered from under the rubble of destroyed buildings in Gaza City.

video:video.video:title: Zelenskyy welcomes US envoys Witkoff and Kushner to Kyiv
video:video.video:description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Kyiv on Sunday.

video:video.video:title: Vikander and Fassbender pose, kiss on Venice carpet
video:video.video:description: Notoriously private couple Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender posed together at 'The Echo Chamber' screening in Venice. (Sept. 6)

video:video.video:title: For tick bite allergy sufferers, Kentucky farm selling ostrich that tastes like forbidden red meat
video:video.video:description: Ostrich farmers say they’re finding new customers who suffer from a strange red meat allergy contracted from ticks.

video:video.video:title: Vessels seen on Strait of Hormuz by Bandar Abbas, Iran as sun sets
video:video.video:description: Iran said Sunday it struck an unmanned U.S. vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz, a claim that the U.S. military dismissed as a “total lie.”

video:video.video:title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in Ukraine after meeting with Putin
video:video.video:description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv on Sunday, a day after talks with Putin in Moscow.

video:video.video:title: Germany's far-right AfD celebrates victory in Saxony-Anhalt state election
video:video.video:description: The far-right Alternative for Germany party has surged to a resounding victory in a regional election.

video:video.video:title: AP top stories September 7
video:video.video:description: Here's the latest for Monday, September 7: Five killed after Amazon cargo plane barrels off runway; U.S. envoys hold talks in Kyiv aimed at ending Ukraine war; far-right Alternative for Germany party surges to victory in regional election; Indonesian volcano erupts causing flight cancellations.

video:video.video:title: Miami officials say five dead, five in hospital after Amazon plane crashes off airport runway
video:video.video:description: Authorities said at least five people were killed after an Amazon cargo plane barreled off a Miami airport runway and collided with cars.

video:video.video:title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in Ukraine after meeting with Putin
video:video.video:description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks in Kyiv on Sunday in their first official visit to Ukraine, but made no breakthrough toward ending Russia’s full-scale invasion.

video:video.video:title: Amazon cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport
video:video.video:description: An Amazon cargo plane barreled off a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, striking multiple vehicles and bursting into flames in a crash that forced the closure of all runways at one of the nation’s busiest airports.

video:video.video:description: Rescuers continued to search for the missing at Gyirong Port near the Nepal-China border more than a week after it was engulfed by a mudslide following a glacier collapse.

video:video.video:description: Search and rescue teams combed through the debris of a collapsed building in New Delhi on Monday as the death toll climbed to at least six, according to officials.

video:video.video:title: Nepal holds day of mourning to remember victims of devastating floods
video:video.video:description: Nepal held a day of mourning Monday to remember those killed in the Aug. 26 floods, with flags lowered at government offices and families concluding mourning rituals.

video:video.video:title: Sarandon says she lost work over politics
video:video.video:description: Speaking at a Venice Film Festival press conference, Susan Sarandon said she's still losing work because of her public support of Palestine.

video:video.video:description: Thousands of mourners paid their respects on Monday as the body of Ratko Mladic, the Bosnian Serb commander who died while serving a life sentence for war crimes, was lying in state.

video:video.video:title: Miami officials say at least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crash
video:video.video:description: Federal investigators on Monday are detailing their plans for determining what caused an Amazon cargo jet to barrel off a runway at Miami International Airport, killing at least five people and injuring five others as it struck vehicles and was engulfed in flames.

video:video.video:title: Several killed in Israeli airstrikes on village in southern Lebanon
video:video.video:description: At least nine people were killed, with several others wounded, including women and children, according to Lebanon's Health Ministry.

video:video.video:title: German chancellor faces pressure after far-right AfD wins state election
video:video.video:description: A small eastern German state has delivered a political shock with consequences far beyond Germany. The AfD, classified by Germany's domestic intelligence agency as an extremist group, fell just short of an outright majority in Sunday's regional elections.

video:video.video:title: David Harbour wins his first Emmy
